info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Faction Warfare API
EVE Online Overview of a Character Involved in Faction Warfare

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Statistical overview of a character involved in faction warfare

---
Alternate route: `/dev/characters/{character_id}/fw/stats/`

Alternate route: `/legacy/characters/{character_id}/fw/stats/`

Alternate route: `/v1/characters/{character_id}/fw/stats/`

Alternate route: `/v2/characters/{character_id}/fw/stats/`

---
This route expires daily at 11:05
